'''Lunaara''' was an ancient [[Anarrian]] hero. A statute of Lunaara was located in the center of [[Lunaara Square]], a public meeting place situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rastar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altiria/Anarris]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
